title: Structural Distortion Explorer
summary: An exaggerated, qualitative and unit-free 3D view of how axial load, transverse shear, torsion, bending, warping, shear lag and threshold-triggered buckling distort a draggable, rotatable amber patch of skin on a cantilevered circular tube, rectangular box and I-beam, and on a stiffened panel with toggleable stringers and frames. A synced 2D inset shows the patch with red and blue principal arrows and the shear-angle arc; colour maps show shear strain, axial strain and warping; a warping-restraint toggle, six presets and a narrated Markdown deck of the view to open in beamdswitch for slides and a video. Every effect is labelled analytic or assumed shape. Not to scale, no units.
